agreement_rule:
z = (ln R_epsf - ln R_aperture) / sqrt(s_epsf^2 + s_ap^2), s = fractional errors
  compatible |z| < 3, discrepant |z| >= 5, inconclusive otherwise or if a fit failed.
Both methods read the same photons, so their errors are positively correlated
and this denominator is too large: "discrepant" is conservative, "compatible"
is lenient. That is stated with the result, not hidden.

normalisation.note: Amplitude is free, so a normalisation error cannot raise chi2; it only scales the flux. The phase dependence (0.983-1.018) moves single-epoch fluxes and so ratios; see variant normalise_native.

blending.note: The pair is 0.27 px apart: with a free position its flux ratio is not constrained (values swing through zero), so it is fitted as one source.

uncertainty.note: Bootstrap resamples the normalised residuals at the fitted position (300 draws); it ignores their spatial structure, so like chi2 scaling it treats a PSF-shape error as noise.
